text: ポケモンって　いろんな　せいかくが　あるのよね　わたしの　ピカチュウは　せっかちな　せいかく　だから　すばやい　ポケモンに　そだったわ！

structure.jp: いろんな　せいかくが　あるのよね
structure.en: have all sorts of natures, don't they

structure.jp: わたしの　ピカチュウは
せっかちな　せいかく　だから
すばやい　ポケモンに　そだったわ！
structure.en: it grew into a fast Pokémon!

patterns.name: 〜って
patterns.explanation: って after a word is a chatty way of bringing it up as the thing you are talking about. ポケモンって = 'Pokémon, you know'.

patterns.name: 〜から
patterns.explanation: から after a statement gives it as the reason for what follows. せっかちな　せいかく　だから = 'because it has a Hasty nature'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の gives an explaining tone in soft feminine speech, and よね asks the listener to agree. あるのよね = 'they do have them, don't they'.
